claude_proposed_widenings.name: PolymorphFormSource — open creature type with exclusions
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Shapechange allows any creature type (except Construct and Undead). The current PolymorphFormSource.creatureType accepts a single CreatureType value. There is no variant for 'any creature type' or 'any except [list]'. A new variant such as { kind: 'any_except'; excludedTypes: ReadonlyNonEmptyArray<CreatureType> } is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The new form must be of a creature that has a Challenge Rating no higher than your level or Challenge Rating. You must have seen the sort of creature before, and it can't be a Construct or an Undead.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: PolymorphRetainedField — 'proficiencies' and 'spellcasting_feature'
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Shapechange retains all proficiencies (weapon, armor, saving throw, skill) and the Spellcasting feature. The existing field 'skill_proficiencies' covers only skill proficiencies, not the full set. 'spellcasting_feature' does not exist at all. Both variants are needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you retain your creature type; alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; proficiencies; and ability to communicate. If you have the Spellcasting feature, you retain it too.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: transform_target — midDurationSwitchAs field for open-catalog re-form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Shapechange allows re-forming into a different eligible creature mid-duration using a Magic action, choosing freely from the open creature catalog each time. CastTimeEffectModeChoice.allowsMidDurationSwitchAs exists but only applies to switching among predefined authored mode options, not to an open catalog re-selection. transform_target needs a parallel field (e.g. midDurationSwitchAs?: 'magic_action') that signals open-catalog re-form at the action cost.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You shape-shift into another creature for the duration or until you take a Magic action to shape-shift into a different eligible form.

discrepancies: no content/shapechange.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
